literature_notes: Three ledger lines were evaluated. L1 (PMID 16542157) describes AP-tagged APP used as a substrate to measure ADAM8 shedding activity; no tag is placed on ADAM8 itself, and the E330Q mutation is a catalytic point substitution, not a tag insertion — disqualified. L2 (PMID 16542157) confirms a C-terminal BiPro epitope tag on full-length ADAM8 expressed in HEK293 cells; the C-terminus (residue 824) falls in the intracellular domain (topology 678–824), so this is not an extracellular surface site — recorded in other_positions. L3 (PMC11100242) reports 'Flag-ADAM8 (GeneChem)' full-length and deletion constructs used to study intracellular interactions with the nuclear transcription factor Fra-1; the clip names a commercial plasmid and states no tag position, which the rules explicitly disqualify ('a commercial plasmid whose tag POSITION is unstated; you cannot pin insert_after_residue'). The intracellular-interaction context further raises doubt that the Flag is extracellular. No ledger line supports a surface tag site.

literature_other_positions.note: C-terminal BiPro epitope tag on full-length ADAM8 confirmed by anti-BiPro western blot in HEK293 cells; residue 824 lies in the intracellular domain (topology 678–824), so this tag faces the cytoplasm, not the extracellular surface.
